strings.zh: 我在路过地下通道的时候,{NEWLINE}被一群气势汹汹的训练家给吓了一跳。{CLEAR}听说他们好像要搞什么地下决斗。
strings.en: When I was passing through{NEWLINE}the Underground, a bunch of{CLEAR}fierce-looking Trainers gave me{CLEAR}a fright. I hear they’re holding{CLEAR}some kind of underground battles.

strings.zh: 地下通道又恢复了往日的平静,{NEWLINE}这下可以安心带精灵去做美容了。
strings.en: The Underground is back to its usual{NEWLINE}calm. Now I can take my Pokémon{CLEAR}to get groomed without worrying.

strings.zh: 我刚刚和我可爱的精灵{NEWLINE}在地下通道照了大头贴哦！
strings.en: I just took photo-booth pictures in{NEWLINE}the Underground with my cute Pokémon!

strings.zh: 我想带着信使鸟{NEWLINE}去地下通道照张大头贴,{CLEAR}但是又怕遇上搞地下决斗的那帮人……
strings.en: I want to take Delibird to the{NEWLINE}Underground for photo-booth{CLEAR}pictures, but I’m afraid of running{CLEAR}into that underground battle gang...
